Still here, each for a reason: bun-tools is runtime-linked (src/runtime/cli/tools_command.rs embeds src/tool-assets.json); bun-supervisor has runtime tests in test/js/bun/supervisor and is used by release-portable-npm; bun-cloudflare is imported by scripts/aphrody/media-sdk-publish.ts; bun-fuzzy is a root workspace used by the publish-npm tests; bun-google and bun-chromium back the bun:google and bun:chromium builtins and the Google/Chromium graph; bun-nginx, bun-winsvc, bun-cosmic, bun-webview-core, bun-oxc and bun-n2b are root Cargo members, and bun-nginx feeds release-native-nginx; bun-dotnet pairs with bun-dotnet-host, a non-optional bun_runtime dependency; bun-x is a root workspace; aphrody-pkg-system is a Cargo member. Each needs its consumers moved or made optional first.

factory/ stays: 572 references; it holds the runtime's own qualification receipts and the default outputs of runtime scripts (Bun OS runtime-heavy-migration B2). patches/chromium and docs/chromium stay: scripts/aphrody/chromium.ts and chromium-patches.ts (bun run chromium patch) apply and refresh them, and docs/chromium is in the Google/Chromium graph surface; they move only together with the Chromium tooling. scripts/aphrody/alpine stays for now: its wgpu-probe example is a root Cargo member and its WSL scripts are runtime setup.

It can move to vendor/curl as a pinned fetched dependency like the others (the receipt check and the bootstrap script go), or to a submodule; not moved in this lot.
